notes.title: My Safe House: Release Date Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32533397/8859043ede28c434cf756ba5196b97f72ecd77c7.jpg[/img]

Hello, we are StoryTale Studios.

We really appreciate your kind and supportive feedback on My Safe House! It really made our day ːsteamhappyː

We have a good news! The release date for My Safe House has been moved to [b]April 20, 2018 at 9.00 PM PDT[/b]. We hope by this you can get My Safe House experience faster.

Kind regards,
StoryTale Studios
